alkylation reagent: followed by treated with 50 mM 2-chloroacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3 for 45 min at room temperature avoiding light
alkylation concentration: followed by treated with 50 mM 2-chloroacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3 for 45 min at room temperature avoiding light
cleavage agent: rehydrated with 50 mM NH4HCO3 solution containing 20 ng/μl trypsin for digestion overnight at 37 °C
collision energy: followed by data-dependent HCD MS/MS, which has a resolution of 7500 with a collision energy of 35%
enrichment method: the gel portions including ubiquitinated substrate bands or the related ‘smears’ were cut and collected
instrument: LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer
MS analysis was performed on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: Label-free tandem mass spectrometry was used to map the sites of ubiquitination in NDP52, OPTN, and SQSTM1 after WWP2Y369E treatment
mass analyzer: the Orbitrap spectra were collected from m/z 400 to 1800 at a resolution of 30,000
ptm: static modification, Cys carbamidomethylation; variable modifications, Met oxidation, Lys ubiquitination (di-Gly modification) and acetylation, and Ser/Thr/Tyr phosphorylation

Database search parameters were as follows: enzyme, trypsin; precursor mass tolerance, 10 ppm; fragment ion tolerance, 0.03 Da; static modification, Cys carbamidomethylation; variable modifications, Met oxidation, Lys ubiquitination (di-Gly modification) and acetylation, and Ser/Thr/Tyr phosphorylation.
reduction reagent: the gel pieces were dried using a SpeedVac and treated with reducing agent TCEP in 100 mM NH4HCO3 for 60 min at 55 °C
